data.one_liner: Flutter build and release CLI to automate version bumping, file naming, and uploads.
data.what_it_does: Dart-based CLI tool that bumps app version numbers, executes customized Flutter builds, renames output artifacts, and uploads them to Firebase App Distribution, Telegram, App Store Connect, or Google Play.
use_when: You want to automate building and distributing Flutter releases from the command line.
You prefer a pure Dart alternative to Ruby-based fastlane for deployment scripts.
avoid_when: You are looking for a runtime package or library to integrate into your app's code.
You manage deployments strictly via CI/CD platforms using standard build scripts.
strengths: First-class support for Flutter flavors and automated artifact renaming.
No external dependencies like Ruby, Gemfile, or fastlane required.
Multi-language support for error logs and messages (English, Uzbek, Russian, Turkish).
weaknesses: Relies on local machine CLI execution or manual setup for remote CI environments.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally via `dart pub global activate dartdosh` and run `dartdosh init` in your project folder.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate dartdosh
dartdosh init
dartdosh build apk -p
